Muslims across Palestine marked yet another Eid amid Israeli strikes, raids,
and other violence. Those in Gaza were once again blocked from making the Hajj
pilgrimage.

Over the last week alone, Israel killed more than two dozen Palestinians in
Gaza, including several children. One strike severed a baby's leg and[
reportedly](https://www.instagram.com/p/DYxD1dtOSSd/) killed his mother. At
the same time, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the military
to take control of 70% of Gaza - yet another clear example of how the supposed
"ceasefire" was in name only.

In the occupied West Bank, Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man during a
raid in Jenin on Eid al-Adha. They also [stormed and
closed](https://www.newarab.com/news/israel-restricts-access-hebrons-ibrahimi-
mosque-during-eid) Hebron's Ibrahimi Mosque.
